title: Require production graphs to compose registered recipes only
narrative: Production graphs are composed from registered recipes (including nested recipes), not free-form node synthesis. Tiling and recipe-as-tool already help (`fangore_recipe_namespace_tile`, `fangore_recipe_as_tool`). Tracks MH-SR-02[^insp-sr-02].
implementation: `GraphTemplateRegistry.composition_violations(graph)` / `assert_registry_composed(graph)` check that a recipe-stamped graph names a stored `name@version` and that an unstamped container graph holds only embedded recipe subgraphs, recursively. Free-form nodes and forged versions are reported. Hosts call it as a production gate; the executor does not force it.
validation: Kind `registry_only_compose`. Hard expects pure tiling of registered recipes to pass, a free-form shell node and a forged recipe version to be reported.
